title: Cardealer conformance test file
description: An array of groups. A group names what it covers; each of its tests gives the data and whether the model accepts it. The layout follows JSON-Schema-Test-Suite.

description.description: What the group covers; unique within the file

comment.description: Context for maintainers; never read by a runner

specification.description: Links to the spec sections the group exercises

description.description: What the test checks; unique within the group

comment.description: Context for maintainers; never read by a runner

data.description: The value the model parses: a row for a table model, a dataset descriptor for the dataset model. Cardealer URLs carry the literal {version}, which a runner replaces with its VERSION first

valid.description: Whether the model accepts the data
